notes.title: Season finale trailer and release date
notes.notes:
The Wolf Among Us season finale, Cry Wolf, will be arriving for download on Tuesday, July 8th.    

Don't miss the trailer below if you've already caught up on the season so far - this one is a must-watch!

notes.title: Release date for Episode 2!
notes.notes:
Great news for those eagerly awaiting a release date for Episode 2 of The Wolf Among Us! Episode 2: Smoke & Mirrors will be out on Steam on Tuesday, February 4th. 

Only a few days to go, guys!
